component.name: vrcd
component.summary: VRChat companion: live friend feed, log watching, screenshot metadata

description.p: vrcd is a companion application for VRChat. The client connects to a vrcd server that maintains a live link to VRChat's event stream, lets you browse friend activity and instance state, monitors the local game log, and writes rich metadata (author, world, players) into screenshots.
The UI is built for VR-friendly interaction with large, clearly labeled controls.

screenshot.caption: Event feed with friend activity history

description.p: The client moves from SDL2 to SDL3.

ul.li: Stickers and emoji are split into the ones you uploaded and the exclusive ones VRChat handed out.
Any piece of content with artwork can be downloaded at its original size.
The window icon is found beside the binary and in the installed icon theme, so a launcher-started copy gets one too.
The client no longer dies when the server connection drops.
Reconnecting to VRChat now takes two seconds instead of thirty, and friend state is refreshed every 30 minutes.

description.p: A web front-end, usable from a phone, and inventory support.

ul.li: Web front-end: friend list, notification inbox, profile viewing and editing, mute and block management.
Inventory, items and stickers in both the client and the web front-end.
Joining an instance works on Windows and Linux.
World metadata is cached across restarts.
